claims.claim: FEMA is Act 42 of 1999, enacted 29 December 1999
claims.evidence: Department of Economic Affairs full Act, heading

claims.claim: FEMA replaced FERA 1973 with effect from 1 June 2000
claims.evidence: Department of Revenue official explanatory page, corroborated by FEMA section 49(1)

claims.claim: FERA was repealed as part of the original July 1991 reforms
claims.evidence: FEMA 1999 section 49 repeal and 1 June 2000 commencement

claims.claim: FEMA's statutory purpose includes facilitating external trade and payments and orderly development and maintenance of the foreign exchange market

recommended_student_wording: The 1991 economic reforms initiated liberalisation, but the statutory replacement of the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1973 by the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 took effect only on 1 June 2000. FEMA's stated objective is to facilitate external trade and payments and promote orderly development and maintenance of India's foreign-exchange market.
limitations: This is a bounded statutory chronology check, not verification of all Mains 4 claims.
